notes.title: Patch 2.2.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Before boss battles on boards, MP of all actors are now restored by 12.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.2.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Home: The scarecrow now counts 19 hidden items.
[*] Forgotten Desert: The scarecrow now counts 7 hidden items. The enpuzzled chest now opens properly.
[*] Hexagon Tower: Removed the lift test messages. Whoops! :D
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[*] Made a lot of minor improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.2.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Using enemy skill cards no longer restores MP.
[*] Gloomers: Adjusted the stats.
[*] Seraphims: Now use Holy Shot instead of Trine.
[*] Ruin: Now deals 15 damage (down from 45), or 30 damage (down from 90) if the target is stunned.
[*] Grave of Thorns: Can't hit critically anymore.
[*] Absolute: Now has a 50% chance to stun instead of a 25% chance to kill instantly.
[*] Dragon's Breath: Now halves DEF instead of doubling it. Now costs 8 MP (up from 5). This is now the only skill that actually costs more than 5.
[*] Battles backgrounds are now darkened.
[*] Kalra Catacomb: Fixed the antique lore book animation.
[*] Added an NPC in a later area who sells enemy cards.
[*] Added some minor content here and there.
[*] Made a lot of minor optimisations and fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.2.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated the URL on the title screen.
[*] The switchboard puzzle doesn't reset to the first letter phase anymore once you've solved that.
[*] Added a hint how to progress after getting Brutus.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get multiple Filthy Glues.
[*] Optimised enemy sprite positions.
[*] Hushlands: Elsa's mother now gives you a potion whenever you don't have any left.
[*] Added some smoke to Linve's chimney when she's home.
[*] Fixed some minor bugs.
[*] Optimised some maps.
[*] Fixed and optimised some texts.
[*] Fixed and optimised some graphics.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Made various little changes (especially in the early game) based on player feedback. For example, you now get the reward from the switchboard puzzle after solving the first part, and the second part rewards you with Great Potions and Repair Kits.
[*]Fixed a few minor errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.2.0 (Expansion)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added another postgame episode after the Rain Sequence: Grandora Island!
[*]Changed Elsa's angry expession.
[*]If Elsa is Tinker, some books raise her max MP by 1. There are 10 such books throughout the game. This enables her to use skills much earlier without an MP-Cost buff.
[*]Added some hints in the early game to make it more obvious how to progress.
[*]Neith: For every 3 training sessions, Elsa's STR, DEF and TMP grow by 1.
[*]Bot Spring: Can now be used even when you don't have 10 Cent.
[*]Jerax: Special ability reduces HP of all actors by 15 instead of reducing them to 1.
[*]Kalra Ruins: Added a hint where to find the posters.
[*]Arena Temple: Changed the floor and wall graphics.
[*]Added a lazy swirl between portal #4 and the Lantern Maze entrance.
[*]HEM Rockin: Now deals 5 to 15 damage, or 15 to 45 damage to stunned enemies.
[*]Keywarden: Reduces MP of all actors by 15 instead of reducing them to 0.
[*]Moonlight Palace: Changed the floor graphics.
[*]Bell & Flask: Can now be received from the Blacksmith in the Forge if it has been missed.
[*]Added a lazy swirl between the Whispering Lawn and the Slumberwoods.
[*]Sunlight Sanctuary: Changed the floor and wall graphics, optimised the water, statues and book shelf colours.
[*]Kalra Catacombs: Changed the floor and wall graphics.
[*]Added a lazy swirl in the Forgotten Desert between the tower entrance and the place of Elsa's first arrival.
[*]Rainbow Ribbon: Can now be found in another place if it has been missed. The chest only appears very late in the game, though.
[*]After finding 14 Blue Crystals, there will be a visual indicator on the remaining objects that aren't 'what they seem to be'.
[*]Optimised some maps.
[*]Removed the blue-crystal robot from the Moonlight Palace Library. There were actually 22 Blue Crystals in the game (whoops!), so I removed this one because it was probably the hardest one to get.
[*]Fixed some minor errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] HEM Rockin: Now deals 15 to 45 damage to all enemies (down from 15 to 75), or 15 if they have Guard. Removed the additional 10% damage variance.
[*] Mirror Shield: Now enables Shield Bash LV 3 as stated.
[*] Engineer: No longer gives you an unlimited amount of Repair Kits.
[*] Slumberwoods: Fixed a mapping error.
[*] Green fields: If Elsa levels up via a green field as Fighter, her training points are now raised properly and old levels of skills removed.
[*] Board #4: Fixed a red board field that would allow movement where it should have been restricted.
[*] Board #6: Fixed a green field that had its activation linked to another one.
[*] Blacksmith: Now works properly (fixed several bugs).
[*] Priest: No longer gives you an unlimited amount of Blue Crystals.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Home: Lowered the volume of the birds singing in the background.
[*] Bell & Flask: No longer repeatedly grants Luminous Tears.
[*] Wooden Hammer: Now attacks with a 12.5% chance to cause Stun.
[*] Tronic Hammer: Now attacks with a 25% chance to cause Stun.
[*] Megatronic Hammer: Now attacks with a 37.5% chance to cause Stun.
[*] Gigatronic Hammer: Now attacks with a 50% chance to cause Stun.
[*] Basso: Lowered TMP from 6 to 4.
[*] Behemoth: Lowered TMP from 9 to 6. Replaced 'Meteo Crusher' with 'Break' in its skill list.
[*] Gargoyle: Lowered TMP from 9 to 6.
[*] Gloomer: Lowers ATK from 21 to 14.
[*] Lamia: Lowered TMP from 9 to 6.
[*] Blizzard Beast: Lowered TMP from 15 to 10.
[*] Optimised some tiles.
[*] Fixed some mapping errors.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Workshop: Fixed an error with the BGM not playing.
[*] Optimised some maps.
[*] Fixed, changed and added some texts.
[*] Fixed a bug with the menu. (Thanks, ICF-Soft!)
[*] Made it clearer that the way forward is through the first Game portal.
[*] Made it clearer that the way forward is through the Hushlands and that you can actually solve the lily-pad puzzle at that moment.
[*] Everwhite: If you don't have Marimba yet, the Elder gives you a hint.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.1.0 (Expansion)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Grumpy Wisp Card: Fixed the icon.
[*] Optimised some graphics and maps.
[*] Added the reward for finding all Blue Crystals.
[*] Added a new episode to the game with new music.
[*] Added new maps, one with new music.
[*] Added a new boss.
[*] Added some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed Elsa's face graphics enhancing her feminine features.
[*] Jelly: Changed max HP to 10 (down from 20) and max MP to 6 (up from 3).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Sesame Hideout to be pitch-dark.
[*] Removed, changed and fixed some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Engineer: Unless you're a Tinker, now trades components for Repair Kits.
[*] Enfeeblement X/Y (gear): Updated the descriptions.
[*] Marimba: Now starts with Soothing Sphere.
[*] Soothing Sphere (skill): Changed HP restoration to 5% (down from 7.5%). 
[*] Duskmare: Changed max MP to 36 (up from 18) and DEF to 18 (down from 36). This should make Board #6 a little less hard.
[*] Green Dragon's trial: Fixed a bug that would get you stuck in a loop as a Champion.
[*] Updated some graphics.
[*] Changed and added some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Engineer: Now gives you 6 Repair Kits (up from 3), but only replenishes them up to 3 once.
[*] Jelly: Now uses Enfeeblement Z instead of Soothing Sphere. The combination of Soothing Sphere and Cure made it too hard to kill Jellies at lower Levels. Enfeeblement Z, on the other hand, only has a minor effect then.
[*] Fixed some mapping errors.
[*] Fixed some minor event errors.
[*] Changed some texts.
[*] Updated the credits.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed some texts (Granuts description and Linve's recipe). Changed the position of the dustbin in Elsa's House. Changed the colour of the tufts that are Miracle Bulbs. This should, once again, make it easier to figure out how to proceed.
[*] Removed some beta graphics.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed some texts (Elsa's comment about the cursed tree and Linve's recipe). This should make it easier to figure out how to proceed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Updated the title image.
[*] Removed a beta text.
[/list]
